how_to_apply: Open the AIIMS Rajkot online application form.
Read the official advertisement and confirm department-wise eligibility.
Enter the required personal, educational, registration and category details.
Select the department for which you want to apply.
Pay the application fee through the prescribed online payment portal, if applicable.
Enter or upload the payment details as required in the application.
Check all entered information carefully before submitting the form.
Submit the online application by 3 October 2026 at 11:00 AM.
Save the submitted application form and fee-payment receipt.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rajkot Senior Resident Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: AIIMS Rajkot follows 4% horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities according to Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: The postgraduate medical degree or equivalent qualification must be obtained from an institution recognized by the NMC or NDC. A Ph.D. must also be obtained from a recognized institution. For Anatomy and Biochemistry, both medical candidates possessing an MBBS degree and eligible non-medical candidates may apply.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years . Category-wise relaxation is available as follows:

rows.conditions: Only for posts reserved for OBC-NCL
Only for posts reserved for SC/ST
Disability must be at least 40%, and the applicant's age must not exceed 56 years
Must have completed three years of regular service in the relevant field
Subject to the applicable Government of India rules

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rajkot Senior Resident Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs.1,29,984 per month . The appointment will initially be for six months or until a regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. The appointment is full-time, and private practice of any kind is prohibited.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid through the prescribed online payment link.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection method will depend on the number of candidates appearing for a department. The complete selection process may include: Written examination, where applicable Shortlisting for interview Document verification Interview Medical examination

content_sections.heading: Minimum Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: These minimum qualifying standards apply to the written test and the final weighted score. Where no written test is conducted, the standards apply to the interview score.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Rajkot Senior Resident Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates are not required to send a hard copy of the application to AIIMS Rajkot. A candidate can apply for a maximum of two departments. A separate application and separate fee payment, where applicable, are required for each department.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Interview
content_sections.text: Printout of the submitted online application Application fee payment receipt, if applicable Valid identity proof Class 10 certificate or mark sheet showing date of birth MBBS, BDS or M.Sc. mark sheets and degree certificates, as applicable FMGE certificate for foreign medical graduates MD, MS, DNB, MDS or Ph.D. mark sheets and degree certificates Postgraduate attempt certificate NMC, NDC, State Medical Council or Dental Council registration certificate, as applicable Experience certificate, if any Research publication documents, if any No Objection Certificate for candidates employed in government institutions, autonomous bodies or PSUs SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS, PwBD or Ex-serviceman certificate, where applicable Official Gazette or notarized affidavit in case of a change of name Candidates must bring all applicable documents in original along with one set of self-attested photocopies. Failure to produce an essential document may result in cancellation of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Rajkot Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Rajkot has announced 64 Senior Resident vacancies across 25 departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for an AIIMS Rajkot Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs.1,29,984 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years. Category-wise relaxation is available according to Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 3 October 2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled for 8 October 2026 from 9:00 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs.1,180, including GST. SC, ST, PwBD and women candidates are exempt from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be a written examination?
faq.answer: A written test will be conducted for departments where more than six candidates appear. If up to six candidates appear, selection will be based entirely on the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can a candidate apply for more than one department?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate can apply for a maximum of two departments, but a separate application and fee are required for each department.
